The correct pair(s) of the ambident nucleophiles is(are)

(A) AgCN/KCN

(B) RCOOAg/RCOOK

(C) AgNO2/KNO2

(D) AgI/KI

options.content: (B) and (C) only
(B) only
(A) and (C) only
(A) only

en.explanation:
Ambident ligands are those which have two donor sites but at once it has the ability to donate either site.
Hence in AgCN/KCN, AgNO2/KNO2, CN-, NO2- have two donor sites act as ambident Nu-.

en.content:
During which of the following processes, does entropy decrease?

(A) Freezing of water to ice at 0C

(B) Freezing of water to ice at 10C

(C) N2(g) + 3H2(g) 2NH3(g)

(D) Adsorption of CO(g) on lead surface.

(E) Dissolution of NaCl in water

Choose the correct answer from the options given below :

options.content: (A), (C) and (E) only
(B) and (C) only
(A), (B), (C) and (D) only
(A) and (E) only

en.explanation:
A, B Freezing of water will decrease entropy as particles will move closer and forces of attraction will increase. This leads to decrease in randomness. So entropy decrease.

C No. of molecules decreasing

D Adsorption will lead to decrease in randomness of gaseous particles.

E NaCl(s) Na+(aq) + Cl–(aq) S > 0

So, (A, B, C, D) decreases entropy.

en.content: The common positive oxidation states for an element with atomic number 24, are :

options.content: +1 and +3
+1 and +3 to +6

en.explanation:
24Cr = [Ar]3d54s1

The element with atomic number 24 is Chromium (Cr). Chromium commonly exhibits several positive oxidation states, which are due to the loss of electrons from both the 4s and 3d orbitals.

Here are the common oxidation states for Chromium :

  1. +2 (as in ) : This is observed where the electron configuration is

  2. +3 (as in : This is the most stable state, with the electron configuration

  3. +6 (as in and : In these cases, chromium exhibits an oxidation state of +6.

Hence, the common positive oxidation states for Chromium are +2, +3, and +6.

Therefore, the correct option is :

Option B : +2 to +6.

hi.content: परमाणु संख्या 24 वाले तत्व के लिए सामान्य सकारात्मक ऑक्सीकरण अवस्थाएँ हैं:
hi.explanation:
24Cr = [Ar]3d54s1

परमाणु क्रमांक 24 वाला तत्व क्रोमियम (Cr) है। क्रोमियम सामान्यतः कई धनात्मक ऑक्सीकरण अवस्थाएँ प्रदर्शित करता है, जो 4s और 3d दोनों कक्षकों से इलेक्ट्रॉनों के त्याग के कारण होती हैं।

क्रोमियम की सामान्य ऑक्सीकरण अवस्थाएँ ये हैं :

  1. +2 (जैसे में) : यह तब देखा जाता है जब इलेक्ट्रॉनिक विन्यास

  2. +3 (जैसे में : यह सबसे स्थायी अवस्था है, जिसमें इलेक्ट्रॉनिक विन्यास

  3. +6 (जैसे और में : इन स्थितियों में क्रोमियम +6 ऑक्सीकरण अवस्था प्रदर्शित करता है।

अतः, क्रोमियम की सामान्य धनात्मक ऑक्सीकरण अवस्थाएँ +2, +3 और +6 हैं।

इसलिए, सही विकल्प है :

विकल्प B : +2 से +6।
